Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.settlement

Class KfePlatformPeerInboundService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.settlement.KfePlatformPeerInboundService
@Service public class KfePlatformPeerInboundService extends Object
Instantly surfaces an inbound history row + push for the recipient when a Kerosene user sends on-chain to another platform address (custodial/cold sink).

Deposit UTXO polling alone is too slow / racy for "na hora" UX: the recipient app stayed blank until a later observe cycle. This path creates the inbound from the known outbound broadcast (txid + amount) and lets the custodial observer only reconcile confs later.

    • KfePlatformPeerInboundService

      public KfePlatformPeerInboundService(KfePlatformOnchainDestinationRouter destinationRouter, KfeWalletRepository walletRepository, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, KfeBalanceMovementRepository movementRepository, KfePaymentRequestRepository paymentRequestRepository, KfeBalanceService balanceService, KfeBalanceMovementRecorder movementRecorder, KfePricingService pricingService, KfeFeeSettlementService feeSettlementService, KfeStatementService statementService, KfeResponseMapper responseMapper, KfeDashboardPublisher dashboardPublisher, KfeAuditLogService auditLogService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<com.kerosene.common.financial.notification.FinancialNotificationPort> notificationPort, KfeBitcoinFinalityPolicy finalityPolicy)
      Creates the peer-inbound projection service and derives its credit finality threshold from policy.
      Parameters:
      destinationRouter - maps on-chain destinations to platform sink wallets
      walletRepository - wallet ownership lookup
      transactionRepository - inbound/outbound transaction persistence and lookup
      movementRepository - existing-credit lookup for idempotency
      paymentRequestRepository - locked payment-request matching and updates
      balanceService - available ledger balance writer
      movementRecorder - idempotent ledger movement recorder
      pricingService - inbound on-chain quote calculator
      feeSettlementService - platform fee ledger writer
      statementService - recipient statement writer
      responseMapper - display payload builder
      dashboardPublisher - post-commit dashboard refresh publisher
      auditLogService - audit trail writer
      notificationPort - optional direct notification adapter provider
      finalityPolicy - source of required on-chain credit confirmations

  • Method Details

    • exposeAfterOutboundBroadcast

      @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW) public void exposeAfterOutboundBroadcast(KfeTransactionEntity outbound)
      Called after a successful on-chain broadcast when destination may be a platform wallet.

      Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW: must not join the caller's completed after-commit synchronization (that leaves a bound EntityManager with no live TX and fails with "no transaction is in progress").
